whenToUse: Parts of a whole with up to about six slices: employment type, traffic source share.
A headline share in the centre with a legend list of values.
avoidWhen: More than six categories or close values — use Bar chart or Bar list.
Changes over time — use Area or Line chart.
a11y: The legend is a real list with values and shares; it is the accessible source of truth.
Slices are not distinguished by colour alone.
